idea-plugin.name: Christmas Code
idea-plugin.description:
An animated ASCII Christmas tree and falling snow behind your code.

  • Rotating character art, warm garlands, glowing ornaments, and presents.
  • One continuous scene across split editors, or a separate tree in each pane.
  • Adjustable background opacity and optional automatic activation on project open.
  • Animation pauses while the IDE window is inactive.

Enable it from Tools > Toggle Christmas Background. Customize it in Settings > Tools > Christmas Code.

Source code and documentation | Report an issue
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release: animated Christmas scene, shared split-editor background, adjustable opacity, and optional automatic activation.

action.description: Enable or disable the animated editor background
